_comment: Settlement tiers (DESIGN §3.3, DECIDED 2026-11-04). ORDER IS INDEX-STABLE: never reorder or remove, only append. Zones are in rings around the centre (ring 1 = centre + 6 neighbours = 7 hexes; 2 → 19; 3 → 37; 4 → 61; 5 → 91; 6 → 127). City 5 rings and metropolis 6 rings decided by Omer 2026-11-04 after the A/B test. GATES (DESIGN §5.8, Omer 2026-11-04): popMin is the population a settlement must reach before it may be upgraded to this tier — town 1,500, city 6,000, metropolis 36,000 (the model runs at scale ×3, see data/economy.json; the town and city gates were deliberately NOT scaled). popMax is informational only (= the next gate). typicalPop is the size range a settlement of this tier usually settles at under the ×3 model (village ~900–2,100; town alone ~10,000, with villages ~18,000; city orbit ~25,000–31,000) — draft, for the UI. 'hall' and 'granary' are the two buildings every settlement has from founding (data/buildings.json).

abandonment._comment: DECIDED by Omer 2026-11-05: a settlement whose population falls below abandonBelow people is removed at the end of that month; whoever is left walks to the parent (if any). Later an 'abandoned settlement' entity may mark the site for easy resettling. The threshold is a draft (×3 scale): cohorts are real numbers and never reach exactly zero.

metropolisUpgrade._comment: PROPOSED (DESIGN §3.3): prerequisites for upgrading a city to a metropolis. Not implemented until roads and institutions exist.
